title: Photoshop kit
currentKept: The theme's current element is kept.
intro: Download the kit, paint in Photoshop what you want to change, then send the file back: each element is checked and you choose what to apply.
exportHelp: The kit reflects the saved state of this theme: one group per element, with where it appears on the site and the instructions.
nothingToCheck: No element to check in this file: nothing was recognised, the theme stays as it is.
foreign: This kit comes from the theme “{from}”, not from “{name}” (the screen where you sent it): it is applied to My theme, and only the redrawn elements change.
referenceKnown: Original kit recognised ({how, select, id {file identifier} other {layer contents}}): whatever has not moved is kept as it is.
referenceUnknown: Original kit not recognised: every element is imported.
decor: Home decor: {count, plural, one {# layer read} other {# layers read}} (from the farthest to the front){ref, select, same {, same composition as the exported kit} changed {, composition changed (the exported kit had {previous})} other {}}.
decorFix: A layer needs fixing: the current decor is kept in the meantime.
fileNoChange: No element of this file changes: the theme's own are kept.
colorsCount: {read, plural, one {# swatch read} other {# swatches read}}: {changed} repainted, {unchanged} unchanged{missing, plural, =0 {} one {, # unreadable} other {, # unreadable}}{ignored, plural, =0 {} one {, # layer ignored} other {, # layers ignored}}.
colorsWarning: Warning: once applied, some colours will make text hard to read ({list}). They will be applied anyway; you can fix them in Photoshop or untick them.
noSwatchPainted: No repainted swatch detected: the theme's colours stay as they are (“auto” shades follow their base). To change a colour, paint the swatch itself (brush, paint bucket, or a layer added in “8 · Palette” on top), then save the .psd.
colorsRepainted: {changed, plural, one {# colour repainted} other {# colours repainted}}; {unchanged} unchanged (an “auto” shade follows its base).
colorsProblem: Insufficient legibility once applied ({first}): they will be applied anyway; you can fix them in Photoshop or untick them.
